scope: Learning-based G1 + dual Dex5-1 seated computer typing without inverse kinematics
qualification: Method-level review, not an exhaustive upstream dataset provenance audit or reproduction. Release status is limited to the inspected pages and versions.

sources.title: RoboPianist: Dexterous Piano Playing with Deep Reinforcement Learning
sources.method: DroQ/SAC variant; learned joint-position commands executed through PD; fingering and dense rewards
sources.ik_assessment: Direct joint action method; no IK controller in the described learned action path
sources.use: Primary conceptual precedent for multi-finger physical key pressing
sources.limits: MuJoCo Shadow hands with movable forearms, not G1/Dex5. Paper's collection of song specialists is not one generalist. PPO proposed locally is not a reproduction of its optimizer.

sources.title: RP1M: A Large-Scale Motion Dataset for Piano Playing with Bi-Manual Dexterous Hands
sources.method: RL-generated specialist trajectories and optimal-transport fingering assignment
sources.ik_assessment: Finger assignment is not a Cartesian-to-joint IK solver; direct joint action task
sources.use: Learned-expert data generation and optional fingering assignment
sources.limits: Shadow-hand piano trajectories are not directly reusable Dex5 joint labels; automatic assignment alone does not require all ten fingers.

sources.title: Dexterous Robotic Piano Playing at Scale
inspected: Paper method sections and v1 release statement
sources.method: Specialist RL data, flow-matching generalist and DAgger state coverage
sources.ik_assessment: Joint-action piano learning route; no project-wide provenance audit performed
sources.limits: Inspected v1 says datasets/models/code will be available upon acceptance; usable release and weights were not verified. Large expert collection is not the proposed minimum experiment.

sources.title: Bi-DexHands / DexterousHands
sources.ik_assessment: Benchmark reference only; task-specific action implementations require audit before adoption
sources.limits: Isaac Gym implementation; not a drop-in Isaac Lab 5.1 G1 keyboard task. Do not transfer benchmark FPS or any floating-hand wrench controls to this project.

sources.title: DextrAH-RGB / DEXTRAH
sources.method: Privileged RL teacher and RGB student with fabric-guided control
sources.ik_assessment: Fabrics are not equated with IK, but this is not the proposed direct joint-policy action layer
sources.limits: Different robot and manipulation task; official README recommends Isaac Lab 2.2.1. Current local 2.3.2 compatibility unverified.

sources.title: Scaffolder
sources.method: Model-based learning with privileged sensing during training, including Blind Deaf Piano
sources.ik_assessment: Not audited as a direct implementation candidate
sources.limits: Dreamer-based route; proposed asymmetric PPO is not a reproduction of Scaffolder.

sources.title: Stay Seated: Learning Omnidirectional Humanoid Locomotion on a Passive Mobile Chair with Casters
inspected: Paper section III: task, chair model, observations, action and PPO
sources.method: PPO; asymmetric actor/critic; 29 normalized G1 joint-position commands executed through PD
sources.ik_assessment: Direct learned joint actions in the described control path
sources.use: Chair contact, observations and later seated locomotion
sources.limits: Starts seated; does not establish stand-to-sit or Dex5 typing. Uses mjlab/MuJoCo. Not the GR00T policy used in the current project. Its 29 body actions overlap the proposed typing arm actions.

sources.title: Enforcing Human-like Kinematics in Dexterous Piano Playing via Adversarial Posture Regularization
sources.method: IK nominal action plus PPO residual; IK prior also in observation
sources.ik_assessment: Uses IK explicitly; excluded from no-IK implementation shortlist
sources.use: Counterexample to classifying all RL piano controllers as no-IK
sources.limits: Style reward could be separately studied only after removing the IK path and auditing demonstration provenance. No drop-in no-IK claim.

sources.title: A hierarchical deep reinforcement learning algorithm for typing with a dual-arm humanoid robot
sources.method: Hierarchical typing learning with KDL Jacobian-pseudoinverse IK below learned actions
sources.ik_assessment: Uses IK explicitly; excluded from no-IK implementation shortlist
sources.use: Clarify why keyboard task relevance alone is insufficient
sources.limits: Not a G1 dual-Dex5 ten-finger direct joint controller.

sources.title: Isaac Lab direct in-hand manipulation and RSL-RL PPO integration
sources.method: Scale, smooth and clamp learned actions; set joint-position targets
sources.ik_assessment: Inspected in-hand action path does not use IK; unrelated G1 manipulation examples may use IK
sources.limits: No Dex5 keyboard environment was reproduced or trained this turn. Installed runtime packages do not establish task feasibility or throughput.
